description: Loss of user funds in VirtualToken's cashIn function due to using msg.value instead of amount for minting, causing ERC20 depositors to receive 0 virtual tokens
LamboFactory can be permanently DoS-ed because createPair can be frontrun by attacker who pre-calculates deterministic token address and creates Uniswap pair first
Calculation for directionMask is incorrect because it assumes WETH is always token1, but Uniswap sorts addresses lexicographically leading to wrong swap direction
Anyone can call rebalance() with arbitrary values for directionMask, amountIn, amountOut, causing the pool to be unbalanced instead of achieving 1:1 peg
Attacker can maliciously consume VirtualTokens by launching cheap pools to exhaust the 300 ETH per block loan limit, preventing legitimate users from launching new pools
Rebalancing formula assumes constant sum AMM (x+y=k) instead of constant product (x*y=k), and ignores inactive tick liquidity, producing imprecise rebalancing amounts
sellQuote and buyQuote are missing deadline checks in LamboVEthRouter, allowing pending transactions to be sandwich-attacked when prices change
Accumulated ETH in LamboVEthRouter will be irretrievable because there is no sweep function and the 1-wei rounding in refunds accumulates over time
Incorrect struct field name (amountIn instead of amount) and hardcoded sqrtPriceLimitX96=0 in _getQuoteAndDirection, leading to runtime failures and no price constraint
Attacker can capture VETH-WETH depeg profits through a malicious pool by crafting directionMask that ORs with uniswapPool to redirect swaps, rendering rebalancer useless
Rebalance profit requirement (profit > 0) prevents maintaining VETH/WETH peg when rebalancing would reduce but not eliminate the depeg
Users can frontrun the rebalance transaction to prevent rebalancing for their gain, causing loss of funds for protocol and its users
Rebalance will be completely DoS-ed if OKX commission rate goes beyond the fee limits, as the flash loan repayment plus commission exceeds the swap output
LP for Uniswap V3 pool of underlying tokens with decimals != 18 would have incorrect NFT metadata due to decimal mismatch in position management
